gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold: abdominal pain. Generated cc-001: lower abdominal pain for a few days, worsening. Core complaint of abdominal pain is present, with added location/duration detail.

Gold: constant periumbilical pain that is worsening. Generated hpi-002 describes constant lower middle abdominal pain below the belly button for several days. This captures constant, periumbilical location, and ongoing nature; duration is an added detail.
Gold: pain severity 8/10. Generated hpi-003: increased in severity to about 8 out of 10. Directly matches severity.

Gold: light per vaginal bleeding. Generated hpi-004 and hpi-007, and ros-003 describe light vaginal bleeding. Additional characterizations (pink, intermittent, distinct from menstruation) are additions but core fact is covered.

Gold: some difficulty passing urine. Generated facts (hpi-011, hpi-012, ros-005) focus on no urinary symptoms/dysuria/frequency and drinking a lot, but do not reproduce 'some difficulty passing urine'. This element is missing.
Gold: daily bowel movements with normal stool. No generated fact mentions normal daily BMs or stool consistency.
Gold: constipation for one week last week. Generated hpi-006: constipation lasting about a week resolving this week. Same concept and duration.
Gold: LMP 2 weeks ago. Generated hpi-008: LMP about 2–3 weeks ago and normal. Core timing is captured; 2–3 weeks is a slight expansion but not contradictory.
Gold: last foreign travel 1 year ago. Generated sh-004: no travel in the past year. Functionally equivalent: last foreign travel one year ago implies none in the last year.
Gold: denies dysuria or frequency. Generated ros-005: no dysuria or frequency. Direct match.

Gold: denies any additional per vaginal discharge. Generated ros-004 has the opposite: 'no abnormal discharge except slight extra discharge.' This is not only missing but reversed, so the gold statement itself is not reflected correctly.
Gold: eating and drinking ok. No generated fact explicitly states normal eating/drinking or adequate oral intake (only vomiting/inability to keep fluids down as future warning).

Gold: has not checked temperature and does not feel feverish. Generated hpi-011 and ros-006 describe no fever, and no fever/chills. Although temp not checked is not stated, the symptom-level absence of fever is captured; the unmeasured temp detail is omitted but the gold fact’s clinical content is represented.
Gold: not feeling faint. Generated ros-010/ros-011: no syncope or dizziness. This encompasses not feeling faint.

Gold: denies shortness of breath or shoulder tip pain. Generated ros-008: no shortness of breath. Shoulder tip pain is not mentioned, but the SOB component is captured; overall at least partially covered. Since the main symptom pair is split, classify as covered with omission of shoulder tip pain detail.
Gold: nausea. Generated hpi-005 and ros-012: nausea without vomiting. Core symptom is present.

Gold: denies vomiting or diarrhoea. Generated hpi-005 and hpi-011/ros-012: nausea without vomiting; no vomiting. Diarrhoea not mentioned, but denial of vomiting is captured. The vomiting component is clearly covered.

Gold: PMH nil significant. Generated pmh-001 uses Past_Medical_History to document amoxicillin allergy, which in gold belongs to allergies, not PMH. There is no statement that PMH is otherwise unremarkable.
Gold: no regular medications. Generated med-001/med-002 mention only the contraceptive implant and its continuation; no statement that there are otherwise no regular meds.
Gold: Implanon inserted 1 year ago. Generated hpi-009 and med-001 clearly state contraceptive implant (Implanon) placed about one year ago. Covered.
Gold: allergic to amoxicillin. Generated pmh-001 and allergy-001 both state amoxicillin allergy. Covered.
Gold: works as a teacher. Generated sh-001: school teacher. Directly consistent.
Gold: has been able to work as usual. Generated social history contains occupation and living situation, but no statement about ability to continue working as usual.
Gold: lives with husband and his family. Generated sh-002: lives with her husband and his family. Direct match.
Gold: no smoker/alcohol/drugs. Generated sh-003: no tobacco, alcohol, or other drug use reported. Direct match.

Gold: assessment abdominal pain ? cause (unclear cause). Generated assessments (asm-001, asm-002, asm-003) specify likely gynecologic etiology and possible contribution of constipation, which implies suspected causes rather than 'unclear cause'. The specific statement of uncertainty is not preserved.
Gold: advised to perform a pregnancy test today. Generated plan-003: repeat pregnancy test today. Directly covered.
Gold: contact clinic immediately if pregnancy test is positive. Generated plan-003: if positive, patient to call immediately for urgent assessment. Directly covered.

Gold: urgent examination with doctor has been booked. Generated plan-001 and fu-001: arrange urgent face-to-face exam including abdominal and pelvic exam. Although phrased more as arrangement than already booked, the intent for urgent in-person assessment is captured.

Gold: to get in touch earlier if pain worsens or new symptoms develop. Generated plan-004, plan-005, and plan-007 advise seeking immediate care if symptoms worsen or new concerning symptoms occur. This matches the follow-up directive.

gen_assessment.reasoning: Gold CC only notes abdominal pain. Generated adds 'lower', 'for a few days', and 'worsening', which are new details not present in the gold CC text, though consistent with HPI.
23-year-old female is not mentioned anywhere in the gold facts; pure addition.

Gold: constant periumbilical pain. Generated: constant lower middle abdominal pain below the belly button for several days. This is a rephrasing with added duration; location and constancy are consistent.
Both state pain has increased to about 8/10.

Gold: light PV bleeding; LMP 2 weeks ago. Generated hpi-004 states bleeding is distinct from her normal period which stopped ~2 weeks ago. The distinction from menses is not explicitly in gold; bleeding itself is supported, characterization is added.
Gold reports nausea and no vomiting/diarrhoea. Generated: occasional nausea without vomiting. This is consistent; 'occasional' is new but not contradictory.
Gold: constipation for a week last week. Generated: recent constipation lasting about a week, resolving this week. Matches duration and timing.

Gold: light PV bleeding and LMP 2 weeks ago, but no statement that bleeding is 'intermittent', 'pink', or specifically 'unrelated' to LMP. These descriptors are not in gold; thus an addition beyond the basic presence of light bleeding.
Gold: LMP 2 weeks ago. Generated: LMP about 2–3 weeks ago and described as normal. The timing is close, but 'described as normal' is not present in gold and is added.
Gold: Implanon 1 year ago, but no information about irregular menstrual cycles. Generated adds irregular cycles, which is new.
Timing of last intercourse (4 days ago) is not mentioned in gold facts.

Gold: 'Not checked temp. Does not feel feverish.' So absence of perceived fever is known, but temperature not checked. Generated: 'reports no fever'. This is close but not strictly contradictory. However, it also says 'no difficulty breathing' without any support in gold; gold mentions no DIB (difficulty in breathing) only in ROS-006, which is present. On balance, this statement is largely supported (no fever, no vomiting, no difficulty breathing) by gold (no feverish feeling, no vomiting, no SOB). Reclassify: SUPPORTED.

Gold HPI-004: some difficulty passing urine, and ROS-001: no dysuria/frequency. Generated: 'no urinary symptoms except drinking a lot'. This directly conflicts with 'some difficulty passing urine' by asserting no urinary symptoms.
No weight loss and no blood in stool/urine are not documented in any gold facts; entirely new negatives.
Prior pregnancy test one month ago is not mentioned in the gold facts; only the plan to check a pregnancy test today is present. This is added historical detail.
Gold ROS does not explicitly restate abdominal pain under ROS; it appears only under Chief Complaint and HPI. Including GI ROS: lower abdominal pain is an added organizational detail not in gold.
Gold: constipation for a week last week. Generated ROS lists constipation last week; consistent reframing under ROS.
Gold: has had some light PV bleeding. Generated: GU ROS notes light vaginal bleeding. Same symptom.

Directly repeats 'no dysuria or frequency'.

Gold does not mention weight loss. 'No weight loss' is additional ROS detail.
Gold: no shortness of breath. Generated: no shortness of breath (part of Respiratory/Cardiovascular). Chest pain is additional but not contradicting.

Gold: not feeling faint. Generated: no syncope. These align conceptually.

Both specify amoxicillin allergy with unspecified reaction.

Gold: teacher. Generated: school teacher. Consistent.
Matches gold: lives with husband and his family.

Gold assessment: abdominal pain ? cause (uncertain cause) and light PV bleeding but no explicit linkage or cause. Generated asm-001 asserts assessment 'includes lower abdominal pain worsening with light vaginal bleeding'—that part is fine—but in the overall assessment set (asm-002) it attributes likely gynecologic etiology, which departs from 'cause unclear'. Considering asm-001 alone, it's a supported restatement of symptoms, not cause; thus better classified as SUPPORTED.

Gold: '? cause' indicates uncertainty. Generated: 'likely gynecological etiology considering timing ... and implant use.' This is a new diagnostic interpretation not in gold; it changes the level of certainty and is not stated in the source, but does not directly contradict specific data, so classified as addition rather than contradiction.
Gold lists constipation as a history item but does not state it may contribute to discomfort. Generated explicitly links constipation as contributing factor, which is an interpretive addition.
Gold: light PV bleeding present, but no statement that it is 'out of expected menstrual pattern' or 'may be related to contraceptive implant'. These are new inferential details.

Gold: nausea is present, but there is no separate assessment line for 'possible nausea without vomiting' or comment on it being non-specific/possibly abdominal pathology; this assessment item is an added synthesis.
Gold records allergy to amoxicillin; generated assessment includes 'allergy to amoxicillin' as an assessed problem. Content is supported.
